paragraphs: Explorance sells software for collecting and analyzing feedback from students and employees. Blue, the survey platform, automates the collection, analysis, and distribution of insights. MLY applies machine learning models built for higher education, human resources, and learning and development. Metrics That Matter serves corporate universities and learning providers measuring employee learning programs.

In higher education the work is course evaluations tailored to an institution's own processes and IT systems. Blue connects to the systems a campus or employer already runs, such as an LMS, HRIS, SIS, or CRM. Surveys adapt their questions and content to each respondent's profile. The platform is described as meeting WCAG 2.2 (AA) and Section 508 accessibility standards. MLY reads open comments against more than 900 topics on the student experience. It also strips personal identifiers automatically. Up to a million comments can be uploaded and analyzed in minutes.

For corporate learning teams, results are compared against a benchmark repository the company puts at over 2 billion data points. The company also runs a conference, headed back to Montreal in 2027 from June 20 to 23.

quote.text: Effortlessly upload up to a million comments into MLY and have them analyzed in minutes.
